summary: FD_TC_023_Travel Completed, APPR, Controllable (Code 99, upline), delay 6 to under 9 hrs, Cash, single pax, Elite 25K
title: Travel Completed, APPR, Controllable (Code 99, upline), delay 6 to under 9 hrs, Cash, single pax, Elite 25K
description:
Checks Tier 2 compensation for an Aeroplan Elite 25K member on a single domestic leg. The delay is 7 hours, with arrival delay code 99: the inbound aircraft was late because of an AC controllable issue upline. DDS should find the 6 to under 9 hour band (EL-02) and the APPR regime. The linked Elite 25K profile means both Cash (CAD 700) and AC Wallet (CAD 840 with the 20% top-up) are offered. The customer picks Cash, paid by Interac in Canada. Also checks CyberSource GREEN, Persona PASS, that only the email is collected, and that the Claims Dashboard shows the Elite 25K tier in a read-only resolved state with Unifier payout routing.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC081: one passenger, Philippe Tremblay (Adult, Aeroplan Elite 25K 9876543210, active and in good standing). One AC domestic leg: AC 430 YUL ? YYZ, May 10, 2026. Scheduled arrival 10:00, actual 17:00 (7h, 6 to under 9 hour band). Cancellation code: NONE. Arrival delay code: 99 (upline, controllable), so Fallback = FALSE. Upline cause: inbound AC 429 YYZ ? YUL arrived late for an AC controllable reason (not on the customer's PNR). No VOL or INVOL changes. AC only. Filed June 13, 2026 (D+34, more than 72 hours after arrival, within 366 days). No duplicate. Not an employee, not an infant. CyberSource set to GREEN. Persona set to IDV PASS. Country of residence: Canada (CAD). Payment: Cash by Interac, email only.
